get_config_default: get the default configuration dict for sentence representation models
get_config_dataset: get the default dataset name from the sentence representation model configuration
get_config_conv_architecture: get the convolutional architecture settings including filters, kernel size, and pooling
get_config_perturbation_budget: get the perturbation budget and max perturbations settings for robust model training
get_config_loss_settings: get the verifiable loss ratio and aggregation method from the model configuration
